Negative guard verified: when GET **/api/form-context is Playwright-mocked to return text/html, formTransport.js logs the exact error '[forms] /api/form-context did not return JSON: the API origin is misconfigured (check REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL)' and the submit is blocked (zero POSTs to /api/contacts/submit captured); NO uncaught SyntaxError appears. rca of the issue: Primary bug (unchanged RCA from problem statement): 43 call sites had been migrated from env-first origin to window.location.origin which broke /api/form-context on static-hosted builds (HTML returned, caused SyntaxError on JSON.parse). Fix: single apiOrigin.js module `export const API_ORIGIN = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || window.location.origin;` imported in all 43 sites; formTransport.getContext() now also rejects non-JSON responses with a clear console error and surfaces a user-facing message. Verified on preview: /api/form-context now returns 200 application/json; career submit returns 200; no SyntaxError in console; negative-guard (HTML response) is caught cleanly and no POST is dispatched.
